covers: The pins and the port of the NEC uPD7759, as MAME's handlers expose them

entries.name: reset_w
entries.behaviour: A high-to-low change resets the chip to idle in stand-alone mode and drops DRQ; the MD level is kept, so slave mode returns only on the next MD falling edge. While RESET stays low, START and MD edges start nothing.

entries.name: start_w
entries.description: The active-low START input that begins a stand-alone sample.
entries.behaviour: A high-to-low change starts a sample only when the chip is idle, in stand-alone mode and RESET is high; otherwise it is ignored. The sample number is the byte last written to port_w: ROM byte 0 holds the highest valid number, and a larger one returns the chip to idle.

entries.name: busy_r
entries.behaviour: Returns 1 when the chip is idle and 0 in every other state, so it is 0 from the accepted START or MD falling edge until the sample ends. The stream is brought up to date before the state is read.

entries.name: port_w
entries.behaviour: The byte is held in an input latch and consumed only when the state machine next reads it, so a later write replaces it. Stand-alone: it is the sample number n; the ROM holds its address bytes at 5+2n (high) and 6+2n (low), start offset is high<<9 | low<<1, and the first block header is at offset+1. Slave: see md_w.

entries.name: md_w
entries.description: The mode select input: low is slave, high is stand-alone.
entries.behaviour: Only a change while idle and RESET high acts, so each slave sample needs MD high, then low. Falling starts the request sequence and slave mode; rising returns to stand-alone. DRQ is answered by port_w bytes: sample count (0x10 or more, else idle; 0xFF usual), ignored, address high, address low, ignored, then block headers and data.
